description: Read a run's progress events in order (beta feature). Events such as step.started, step.completed, budget.warning and run.succeeded in seq order. The call returns once the run is finished and drained or the server closes the stream. Pass last_event_id from a previous call to receive only newer events. Returns events, last_event_id and truncated.

last_event_id.description: Return only events after this seq

name: alterlab_run_stream
title: Stream Run Events (beta)
